_note: 'What should I do now?' steps, keyed by schemas.DisposalCategory. damage_steps always win when damage_detected is true (PRD v1.1 §2.8: Safety > Disposal > Recovery). Enforced in guidance_engine.py, not here.
damage_steps: Do NOT puncture, compress, crush, or bend the item
Do NOT open, disassemble, or attempt repair
Do NOT charge it or connect it to power
Move it away from heat, flames, and flammable materials — ideally onto a non-flammable surface outdoors
Place it in sand or a metal container if it is warm, smoking, or hissing
Contact a hazardous-waste or e-waste service immediately — do not put it in any bin

battery_recycling: Do not place in regular household trash — batteries can start fires in garbage trucks
Tape the terminals (clear tape over each end / connector) to prevent short circuits
Store in a cool, dry place away from metal objects until you drop it off
Take it to a battery recycling drop-off point (many electronics stores and supermarkets have one)
e_waste: Do not place in regular household trash
Back up and wipe any personal data before handing it over (factory reset, remove SIM/SD cards)
Remove any detachable battery and recycle it separately as a battery
Check whether the manufacturer or retailer runs a take-back or trade-in program
Otherwise take it to an e-waste collection facility
hazardous_waste: Do not place in regular household trash
Do not puncture, crush, or open the item
Keep it away from heat, water, and other chemicals
Contact your local hazardous-waste disposal service for pickup or drop-off
specialized_recycling: Do not place in regular household trash
Keep the board/component intact — recyclers recover precious metals from it
Take it to a specialized e-waste recycler that accepts components
If it holds data (drive, SSD), wipe or physically destroy the storage first
general_recyclable: Remove any electronics, batteries, or plastic film first
Flatten or clean it if needed
Place in your regular recycling bin if your local program accepts this material
Check local recycling guidelines for specific rules
reuse_refurbishment: Test whether the device still works
Consider donating, selling, or giving it away
Look into repair options before recycling
unknown: Do not place in regular household trash
Check the item for any labels, markings, or a model number and try another photo
Search for local e-waste drop-off options and ask them what they accept
